definitions.unit: unique review, not a vehicle or owner; topic statistics count each review once per topic
definitions.shares: fractions from 0 to 1; model/country/engine_type maps use all reviews of this topic as denominator
definitions.sentiment: inherited from stage 1; AI does not reclassify reviews or change counts
definitions.neutral: explicit neutral only; undetermined is never silently converted to neutral
definitions.global_sentiment: each original review counted once; combine all its fragments, including fragments without a topic
definitions.negative_rate: negative reviews / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.negative_or_mixed_rate: (negative + mixed reviews) / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.share_of_all_topic_negative_reviews: negative reviews in this segment / negative reviews in the entire topic
definitions.topic_prevalence_in_source_segment: reviews in this topic and segment / all original reviews in this segment
definitions.country_engine_type: joint counts, not products of independent marginal shares
definitions.signals: descriptive comparisons, not causal findings or multiple-testing-adjusted significance results

overview.summary: Across the corpus, owners most often praise the F70 for enjoyable driving, comfort, styling, cabin quality, and efficiency, while criticism concentrates on screen-heavy controls, software and digital-service friction, and scattered unresolved faults or dealer follow-up issues.
limitations: Topic overlap is substantial, so themes should not be added together as if they were separate groups of reviews.
Many topics contain large undetermined portions, so several fragments are too brief or ambiguous to support firm aspect-level conclusions.
Some clusters mix unrelated subjects, especially around lexical matches, which limits how coherently they can be interpreted.
A few supplied topic examples appear sentiment-labeled inconsistently or focus on a different aspect than the topic title, so those summaries should be treated cautiously.
No explicit neutral reviews are present in the supplied statistics, and undetermined feedback should not be read as neutral.

warnings: Topic and sentiment errors from the first stage carry through to this report.
AI summaries describe selected examples; counts always use all source review assignments.
Country associations may reflect sample composition or labelling errors; they do not establish vehicle defect rates.
Small segment counts are retained, but automated signals require the configured minimum sample size.
